workspaceTrust.description: Graphics Workbench executes external tools such as Draw.io, Ghostscript, and pdftocairo, so it is not available in untrusted workspaces.
config.execPath.drawio: Path to the draw.io executable. If not specified, the default command for each OS will be used. (Windows: drawio.exe, macOS: drawio, others: drawio)
config.execPath.ghostscript: Path to the Ghostscript executable. If not specified, the default command will be used. (macOS/Linux: gs, Windows: gswin64c.exe)
config.execPath.pdftocairo: Path to the pdftocairo executable. If not specified, pdftocairo will be used.
config.execPath.rsvgConvert: Path to the rsvg-convert executable. If not specified, rsvg-convert will be used.
config.execPath.qpdf: Path to the qpdf executable. If not specified, qpdf will be used.
config.raster.maxInputPixels: Maximum number of pixels allowed for a raster image input. Increase this value only when processing very large images, as larger images may require significantly more memory.
config.raster.maxAnimationPixels: Maximum total pixels allowed when retaining or splitting all frames of an animated raster image.
config.preview.maxCanvasPixels: Maximum total pixels for a PDF preview canvas. The preview is downscaled when necessary; output files are unaffected.
config.preview.maxDevicePixelRatio: Maximum device pixel ratio used for PDF previews.
config.performance.maxConcurrentHeavyPro: Maximum number of heavy external rendering processes that may run at the same time. Higher values may increase CPU and memory usage.
config.largeOperationWarnings.enabled: Show a non-blocking confirmation warning before operations with large PDF page counts or input sizes. The operation can still be continued.
config.largeOperationWarnings.pdfPages: Warn when a batch contains at least this many PDF pages. Set to 0 to disable page-count warnings; this never forbids processing.
config.largeOperationWarnings.inputSizeM: Warn when a batch contains at least this many MiB of input files. Set to 0 to disable size warnings; this never forbids processing.
config.externalTools.qpdf.timeoutSeconds: Maximum qpdf execution time in seconds. Set to 0 for no timeout.
config.externalTools.drawio.timeoutSecon: Maximum Draw.io execution time in seconds. Set to 0 for no timeout.
config.externalTools.ghostscript.timeout: Maximum Ghostscript execution time in seconds. Set to 0 for no timeout.
config.externalTools.pdftocairo.timeoutS: Maximum pdftocairo execution time in seconds. Set to 0 for no timeout.
config.externalTools.rsvgConvert.timeout: Maximum rsvg-convert execution time in seconds. Set to 0 for no timeout.
config.externalTools.mermaid.timeoutSeco: Maximum Mermaid execution time in seconds. Set to 0 for no timeout.
